children: Nvidia has invested in Verily Health.
Verily, a medical data platform originally started by Google, said Wednesday that the investment from Nvidia is an extension of its financing from March.
The investment comes as Verily is scaling its Pre Platform program, a data and AI platform designed to help healthcare organizations integrate AI into their data systems.
The funding will also support the growth of Verily Me, the company's patient engagement offering.
Verily and Nvidia previously announced a collaboration in October 2025, where researchers using Pre Platform can use Nvidia AI libraries and frameworks.
Verily worked with Nvidia to develop Forecast 1.0, a foundation model that integrates genomics and other data to improve the accuracy of predicting long-term health risks.
Verily's other investors include Alphabet, Series X Capital, UCHealth and others.
